verdict.rationale: A community user confirms Jira has saved searches but calls creating a useful one painful (jira-comm-12). Others praise JQL as the query language behind filtering (jira-comm-17), and the docs list multiple views of work (jira-docs-11). Nothing in the pack shows sharing a saved view via a link, and no first-party doc describes saved filters. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of saved filters/views, evidence of sharing a saved view by link, hands-on corroboration that saved views are usable.
